observed.caption: A wide city street with cars and a bus passes beneath a large curved STAR! movie billboard, with a clock tower and a white Allied Chemical tower in the background under a clear blue sky.
observed.description: A wide multi-lane asphalt street with white lane markings extends into the distance, with a yellow taxi on the left, a dark sedan in the center lane, and a light-colored city bus on the right near the sidewalk. A large curved billboard wraps around a building on the right foreground displaying colorful graphics and large text. Below the billboard is a theater marquee. Behind the billboard rises a tall stepped stone tower with a clock face and a globe on top. On the left-center a tall white modern building with vertical dark windows and a rooftop sign stands along the street, with additional high-rise buildings lining both sides of the street in the background. A group of small pedestrian figures is visible on the sidewalk near the theater. Traffic lights and street lamps are visible over the street. The sky is clear and pale blue with bright daylight casting shadows.
